name: Gravetye Manor

menus.name: Gravetye Dinner
menus.note: Three courses plus complimentary dishes from the kitchen garden; vegetarian and vegan versions at the same price; cheese £23 extra

menus.name: Gravetye Lunch
menus.note: Three courses, not the set menu

menus.name: Set Menu Lunch
menus.note: Choice of two mains; vegetarian and vegan versions at the same price

bookingOpens: Online, or by phone. Tables for people not staying at the hotel can be booked up to six months ahead, and availability for them is limited; hotel guests get a dinner table every night of their stay. The booking time is when menus are presented, so arrive earlier for a drink in the lounge or garden.
cancellation: A card is needed to hold the booking. Cancelling within 24 hours costs £50 a person.
waitlist: If no table shows online for the date, phone 01342 810567 to join the waiting list.
groups: Tables of up to six in the dining room. For seven or more, email events@gravetyemanor.co.uk about the private dining rooms.
dressCode: Smart casual; smart jeans are fine, though in the evening men tend to wear a jacket.
children: Children over seven are welcome in the dining room. Younger children, babies included, only as part of a private party in a private dining room.
photoAlt: The ivy-covered front of Gravetye Manor near East Grinstead, West Sussex
